name: University of Madras
summary: The University of Madras, established in 1857, is one of India's first three universities. Its main campus is at Chepauk, with campuses at Marina, Guindy, Taramani, Chetpet and Maduravoyal; most science departments are at Guindy. It is chiefly an affiliating university — most Chennai arts and science colleges award its degrees — and its own departments mainly teach postgraduate programmes. Its own undergraduate offering listed here is the B.Sc. (Blended), run with the University of Melbourne at the Guindy campus.
